name: PSR-4 autoload
description: Wires PSR-4 autoload configuration into composer.json for the project's PHP source directory.

inputs.description: Root PHP namespace using backslash separators, without trailing backslash (e.g. Acme\Blog). The engine adds the required PSR-4 trailing backslash.
Directory containing the PHP source relative to the project root, without trailing slash (e.g. includes or src).
JSON-encoded form of `namespace` (backslashes doubled). Derived automatically; do not supply.

wiring.description: Merge PSR-4 autoload into composer.json. The namespace key is already JSON-encoded with its trailing backslash (e.g. PHP namespace Acme\Blog renders as JSON key "Acme\\Blog\\") — paste it verbatim. Create the autoload block if absent. Run composer dump-autoload --optimize after applying.
